name: od
summary: Dump files in octal and other formats (-c, -x, -t x1, -An, -N LEN)

options.description: address base: d, o, x or n (none)

messages.invalidType: invalid type string '{type}' (supported here: c, x1, x2, x4, x8, o1, o2, o4, o8)
messages.invalidRadix: invalid output address radix '{radix}'; it must be one character from [doxn]
